user: I'm CUS-0004. Transaction TX-0401, 240.00 EUR: the goods never arrived. Which reason code applies? State the transaction ID and amount too. Do not open a dispute.
answer:
What I did
- Verified your customer record (CUS-0004 — Danylo Kovalenko, account ACC-1005).
- Checked Verta's dispute reason-code guidance.

What I found
- For "goods never arrived" the appropriate reason code is: goods_not_received.
- The guidance also shows the chargeback window for goods_not_received is 90 days from the transaction date (from our documentation).

Transaction details you gave
- Transaction ID: TX-0401
- Amount: 240.00 EUR

What happens next
- I will not open a dispute (per your instruction). If you want me to proceed, I can next check dispute eligibility for TX-0401 and then open a dispute if eligible — tell me if you’d like me to do that.

fragments.text:
Reason code guide
## Choosing a code
The reason code must match what actually happened. A dispute filed under the
wrong code is declined and must be refiled, which may push it past its window.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.

Reason code guide
## unauthorized_debit
Used for a direct debit the customer never mandated. This code carries the
shortest window overall.
